script_text: Pisces, your water element and ruling planet Neptune converge to transform your week. The Sun in Virgo trines sensitive Neptune in your 12th House, awakening deep intuition Monday through Wednesday. Mercury direct in your 6th House clears work fog, but Tuesday grows tense when Mars enters your 1st House in Aries. Wednesday marks your turning point as Venus enters Libra, sliding into your 7th House of love, your first meaningful partnership transit in months. Thursday and Friday bring Venus trining Jupiter in your 10th House, blending romance with career growth. Saturday's Moon in your 2nd House refocuses attention on finances. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House of partnership. Friday is your worst day as Mars forms a square to Chiron in your 5th House, stirring buried emotions. Speak honestly this week — Venus in your 7th House rewards vulnerability. Follow for daily updates.
